component_anchors.text: The disclosed multimedia, white-goods, mobile, and supply-chain activities are recurring businesses, but only consolidated adjusted net profit is supplied and it remains negative across FY2015-FY2017; no component cash, margin, or maintenance-capital bridge is disclosed. 因此，Permits only conditional enterprise recurring-earnings and owner-cash treatment; it does not establish a standalone component value input. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Obtain same-perimeter component revenue, margin, operating-cash, working-capital, and maintenance-versus-growth-capital disclosures over a comparable period. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利只进入条件范围；普通股现金只进入条件范围；对融资压力的影响取决于条件；永久损失进入条件性永久损失路径；估值只作为条件性主要估值输入。晋级检验：Same-perimeter component earnings and owner-cash evidence establishes a recurring range and distinguishes maintenance from growth-capital commitments. 失效检验：Official comparable disclosures show that the consolidated adjusted-profit series cannot represent recurring operations after perimeter, mix, or accounting changes.

FY2017 consolidated operating cash flow was negative and attributed to receivables and unexpired bills, while receivables, inventories, and short-term borrowings were high; the source expressly does not allocate those balances or flows among businesses. 因此，Prevents a base owner-cash range and leaves the financing-loss path unresolved rather than assigning it to an operating component. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Obtain comparable component-level receivable, inventory, operating-cash, borrowing, and cash-conversion disclosures that reconcile to the consolidated accounts. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利不适用；普通股现金尚未形成可承保范围；尚未形成可承保范围；永久损失尚未形成可承保范围；估值尚未形成可承保范围。晋级检验：Component-level cash-conversion and funding disclosures reconcile receivables, inventories, operating cash flow, and borrowings over a comparable period. 失效检验：Official disclosure shows the consolidated cash deficit or debt balances are not economically connected to the disclosed working-capital movements.

FY2017 reported profit includes a stated non-sustainable investment gain from disposal, and named projects have only consolidated project inputs or preparation status without television/display attribution, cash funding, or return evidence. 因此，Excludes disposal gain and unproven project-capital return from primary recurring economics and owner cash. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Demonstrate recurring operating contribution, attributable funding, and subsequent return on each material project with a same-perimeter cash and capital bridge. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利排除；普通股现金排除；不适用；永久损失排除；估值排除。晋级检验：Project-level recurring cash generation and return on attributable capital are evidenced after separating disposal proceeds from operating cash. 失效检验：Official evidence establishes that the FY2017 disposal gain is recurring operating income or that project commitments have no material capital consequence.

economic_section_anchors.text: 驱动：Consolidated adjusted net profit attributable to owners（FY2015-FY2017，单位 CNY）；低 -1.13e+09（FY2015 disclosed consolidated adjusted net profit attributable to owners.），基准 -2.8346e+08（FY2016 disclosed consolidated adjusted net profit attributable to owners.），高 -9.72849e+07（FY2017 disclosed consolidated adjusted net profit attributable to owners.）。正常盈利传导（权限：只进入条件范围）：影响未知：No same-perimeter component-level evidence supports a quantified translation from the reported adjusted-profit history to normal earnings.；保守处理：Do not derive a normal-earnings delta or base range from this history.。普通股现金传导（权限：只进入条件范围）：影响未知：The permitted disclosures do not reconcile adjusted profit to component working capital, maintenance capital, or owner cash.；保守处理：Do not derive an owner-cash delta or base range from this profit history.。价值路线权限：只进入条件性价值路线；不在此生成价值、回报或行动数值。翻转证据：A future official same-perimeter disclosure shows that the FY2015-FY2017 adjusted-profit series is not comparable after business or consolidation-boundary changes.
